{{Top|leg}}
'''Destruct devices''' were installed in [[Starship/Legends|starships]] for security purposes and allowed the owner to remotely destroy the vessel at any time. Around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] installed such a device into the ''[[Forbidden]]'', a ship piloted by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] when his loyalty was questioned by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm]].
